text: [excited] This robot dog just walked out of a thousand-degree fire!
Its secret? A coat. Only a few millimetres thick... [impressed] made from the same stuff that flew on rockets.
Scientists in China sent it into the flames for ten whole minutes.
It climbed the stairs... found the fire... and reported back.
[whispers] Inside, it stayed below eighty degrees.
[deadpan] Just one problem. On the first try... [laughing] all four feet came out on fire.
So they gave it new feet.
[curious] Would you send a robot dog in first? Send this to a firefighter.
